Hi Elena — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Ben (AE) and Kimberly (Finance) to align on the order form edits and tax evidence. Quick answers up front:

- Pricing slab: our pricing is applied pro-rata for the day the tier is crossed; however, we can offer a monthly true-up so the effective unit price for the calendar month reflects the tiered discount once threshold is met. I will mark that as an opt-in concession in the redline.
- Minimum commit: we can convert to a quarterly minimum commit with a modest uplift to the unit price (≈3% on Tier A). Alternatively, we can keep annual min commit with staged billing — happy to surface both options in the redline.
- Net terms: default is Net30 for self-serve customers; for order forms with a committed discount we typically accept Net45 for EU customers. Kimberly, can you confirm the threshold for Net45 and any credit holdback language?
- VAT: we support reverse-charge flow where the buyer provides valid VAT/evidence; we will require the tax documents Kimberly will send.

I attached a first-pass redline (redline-orderform_v1.docx) that highlights three commercial paths (quarterly mincommit, staged annual, and annual with uplift). Can we set a 30m call Friday 12:00 GMT to walk through?

Thanks — Soojin

Soojín / Ben — I reviewed Elena's notes and the attached redline. Finance prefers the quarterly mincommit option if Novaclinic can sign a standard credit application. A few items to add into the order form and SOW:

1) Invoice cadence: quarterly invoicing in arrears is acceptable for a quarterly mincommit; for staged annual commits we'll invoice monthly with a reconciliatory true-up each quarter.
2) Net terms: we can grant Net45 for customers with an executed credit application and a signed order form. Otherwise Net30 stands.
3) VAT / tax evidence: please include the following required items in the onboarding packet — buyer VAT registration number, signed self-billing agreement (if applicable), and a copy of the purchase order. I'll attach a short checklist for Elena's AP team.
4) Credit holdback: propose a 5% holdback on the first invoice of the initial quarter pending completion of onboarding checks (KYC & tax evidence). This avoids delaying delivery but mitigates risk.

Proposed language (to insert in order form):
"If Buyer is granted Net45, Buyer shall provide tax residency and VAT registration evidence within 30 days of execution. Failure to provide acceptable evidence allows Seller to revert invoices to Net30 and assess withholding as permitted by law."

I've attached the tax-evidence-checklist.pdf with the exact fields Novaclinic's AP will need. If Ben can confirm commercial trade-offs on price uplift for quarterly mincommit, we can circulate a final redline for Elena.

Thanks,
